name: smwgraphics-super-mario-maker-p-switch-doors
title: Super Mario Maker - P-Switch Doors
description:
The P-Switch doors seen in both Super Mario Maker and its sequel (all variants except NSMBU).

Includes a normal version which uses custom palette to be accurate to the source games, and also a simple version which doesn't require it (uses vanilla colors in palette 7), at the cost of less accuracy (see third pic).
